{"id":"mimid-4j47","title":"mautrix-mimi: a bridgev2 bridge from mimid-agent's JMAP Chat to Beeper and Matrix","description":"Mark (2026-11-13): make MIMI usable from Beeper and from any Matrix homeserver.

Shape:
- A mautrix-go bridgev2 bridge in Go, self-hosted next to mimid-agent on the user's own machine.
- Beeper: run it with Beeper Bridge Manager (bbctl config --type bridgev2 sh-mimi; self-hosted bridge names must start with sh-). It connects to the beeper.com homeserver.
- Other homeservers: the same binary is an ordinary Matrix appservice, so it also works with Synapse and other homeservers outside bbctl.

E2EE boundary:
- The bridge never holds MLS keys. It talks only to mimid-agent's local JMAP Chat interface (loopback, per-user token), which stays the source of truth and the MLS endpoint.
- Turn on mautrix end-to-bridge encryption so the homeserver (beeper.com or Synapse) relays only Megolm ciphertext between the bridge and the user's Matrix clients. Verify it's on in the config.
- So MIMI's E2EE ends at the user's own agent and is re-encrypted for the user's own devices. Not a hosted decrypting bridge.

Mapping:
- MIMI room to Matrix portal room; MIMI users to bridge ghost users.
- Messages, replies, reactions, edits and attachments via JMAP Chat to and from Matrix events.
- MIMI room policy (roles, bans) maps only partly onto power levels; document the gaps.
- Membership changes go through the agent (MLS Commits), never straight from Matrix room state.

Rules:
- The sender identity is always the authenticated MLS sender (AGENTS.md).
- Ghost users must not be able to impersonate other MIMI users.
- The secrets rules apply to the bridge's logs.

Constraints and risks:
- bbctl connects only to beeper.com; the bridge runs in the foreground (needs a supervisor); self-hosted bridges get community support only (#self-hosting:beeper.com).
- Depends on Beeper keeping self-hosted bridges open.
- One Beeper account per user.

Sources: https://developers.beeper.com/bridges/self-hosting/ ; https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/beeper/bridge-manager ; example bridgev2 bridge beeper/matrix-line-messenger.

Depends on mimid-agent (mimid-1wgh.13) and its local JMAP Chat interface.
